name: Bird Dog

instructions.description: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your trunk and keep your neck long with eyes toward the floor.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg backward until they are in line with your body without shifting your hips.
Pause briefly, then return to all fours and alternate sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count alternating sides with steady trunk control.

variations.variationDescription: Both train trunk stability with opposite-limb motion, but bird dog is performed in quadruped.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Lift only the arm if full opposite-limb control is too challenging.

commentsNotes: Keep the pelvis level and avoid rotating.
Do not lift the leg higher than you can control.
